params.message:
Send every other hostname to the canonical host with a 301

The canonical tag follows the visited host, so each extra domain on the
Forge site (bare trucks-schoutteet.com, schoutteet.com, the Forge host)
would be a full copy of the site in Google. With APP_CANONICAL_HOST set,
CanonicalHost answers any other host with a 301 to the same path and
query on https://<canonical host>. Empty (local, staging before launch):
nothing changes.

DEPLOY.md gets the go-live steps for the domains: DNS (A records only,
mail stays), Forge domains and certificate, environment, Sanity webhook,
checks and the way back.
